column1: #mapping_set_description: Unreviewed proposals of the mapping agent, prompt v2.

column8: author_label
column13: comment

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The column holds the study participant number, so it maps to the CDISC subject identifier (SUBJID); Subject Unique Identifier (NCIT:C69256) was rejected because it denotes an identifier unique across studies.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The column names the recruiting centre, so per the guidelines it records the site's identifier rather than the site itself (Study Site, NCIT:C80403, rejected; Study Site Number, NCIT:C83100, rejected as it implies numeric codes).

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The description specifies biological sex, so the CDISC Sex concept fits despite the column name; Gender (NCIT:C17357) and Sex at Birth (NCIT:C124436) were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Birth Year (synonym Year of Birth, BRTHYR) is the year in which a person was born.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Number of Years of Education (EDUYRNUM) matches years of formal education; Education Level (NCIT:C17953) was rejected as a categorical attainment.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Dominant Hand (HANDDOM) records the preferred hand, which is what R/L/both captures; PATO handedness (PATO:0002201) was rejected because demographics go to NCIT.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Study Subject Enrolled Date (synonym Date of Enrollment) is the date a subject is formally enrolled in the study.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Informed Consent Date (RFICDAT) is the date the participant gave informed consent.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No term for family history of Parkinson disease in first-degree relatives was found, so the generic Family Medical History is the closest broader term; HPO Family history (HP:0032316) is an equally broad alternative.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Clinical idiopathic PD is the enrolment diagnosis Parkinson disease in MONDO; no separate idiopathic or sporadic PD term was found, and monogenic PD subtypes were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: MSA-P is the parkinsonian type of multiple system atrophy; the parent multiple system atrophy (MONDO:0007803) was rejected as broader.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Clinical PSP maps to the MONDO disease progressive supranuclear palsy; the PSP-parkinsonism variant (MONDO:0009839) was rejected as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: MONDO Lewy body dementia carries the synonyms DLB and dementia with Lewy bodies, matching the consensus-criteria diagnosis.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Age Symptom Started covers the onset of any illness-specific symptom, which is broader than the age at the first motor symptom; no motor-specific onset-age term was found, and exactMatch is a reasonable alternative reading.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Age at Diagnosis is the generic term, and naming PD as context does not narrow it; the definition's wording on pathologic diagnosis lowers confidence slightly.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Following the guidelines, carrier status is related to the LRRK2 genetic disease (PARK8); the LOINC LRRK2 Arg1441Gly and Gly2019Ser targeted mutation analysis (LOINC:82139-7) was rejected because it covers two variants and records a report rather than G2019S carrier status.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Bradykinesia on exam is the HPO sign Bradykinesia.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Rest tremor present in any limb is the HPO sign Resting tremor; broadMatch is a defensible alternative because the variable excludes non-limb rest tremor and HPO has no limb-specific rest-tremor term (Limb tremor, HP:0200085, rejected).

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Rigidity on exam is the HPO sign Rigidity; the narrower Cogwheel rigidity (HP:0002396) and Extrapyramidal muscular rigidity (HP:0007076) were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Postural instability on the pull test matches HPO Postural instability, whose definition cites the retropulsion test.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Freezing episodes when walking is the HPO sign Freezing of gait.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A self-reported reduced sense of smell is HPO Hyposmia; Partial hyposmia (HP:0010635) was rejected as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No sense of smell is HPO Anosmia; Total anosmia (HP:0010632) was rejected as an unnecessary refinement.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Dream enactment reported by the participant or partner is recorded as a sign, so it maps to the HPO term REM sleep behavior disorder rather than a MONDO disease.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Fewer than 3 bowel movements a week or laxative use is the HPO sign Constipation; Chronic constipation (HP:0012450) was rejected as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A 20/10 mmHg drop on standing defines HPO Orthostatic hypotension; the autonomic-dysfunction subtype (HP:0004926) was rejected as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Urinary urgency maps directly to the HPO term of the same name.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Per the guidelines, a clinician-judged condition other than the enrolment diagnosis is a sign or symptom, so it maps to HPO Depression rather than a MONDO depressive disorder.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Visual hallucinations in the last month is HPO Visual hallucination, and the recall window does not change the concept; the parent Hallucinations (HP:0000738) was rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: HPO has no mild cognitive impairment term, so PD-MCI is mapped as a sign to the broader HPO Cognitive impairment; NCIT Mild Cognitive Impairment (NCIT:C215366) as an exactMatch is a close alternative.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: HPO has no levodopa-induced dyskinesia term, so the broader HPO Dyskinesia is used; MONDO drug-induced dyskinesia (MONDO:0006732) was rejected because it is a disease term for a sign, and Extrapyramidal dyskinesia (HP:0007308) is a possible alternative.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Difficulty swallowing is HPO Dysphagia.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Neither LOINC nor NCIT has a code for the MDS-UPDRS Part I total, so the instrument is a broad match; the LOINC codes for the original UPDRS were rejected because they cover a different instrument version.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Neither LOINC nor NCIT has a code for the MDS-UPDRS Part II total, so the instrument is a broad match; the LOINC codes for the original UPDRS ADL panel were rejected as a different version.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Neither LOINC nor NCIT has a code for the MDS-UPDRS Part III total (OFF state), so the instrument is a broad match; the original UPDRS motor examination panel (LOINC:77720-1) was rejected as a different version.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Neither LOINC nor NCIT has a code for the MDS-UPDRS Part III total (ON state), so the instrument is a broad match; the original UPDRS motor examination panel (LOINC:77720-1) was rejected as a different version.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Neither LOINC nor NCIT has a code for the MDS-UPDRS Part IV total, so the instrument is a broad match; the original UPDRS complications of therapy panel (LOINC:77721-9) was rejected as a different version.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: This is the Hoehn and Yahr stage item of the MDS-UPDRS; the modified Hoehn and Yahr stage of the original UPDRS (LOINC:77714-4, NCIT:C100943) was rejected, as the guidelines require.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: LOINC has a code for the MoCA total score, so it is preferred over NCIT Montreal Cognitive Assessment Total Score (NCIT:C162720).

column5: Geriatric depression scale (GDS) short version total
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The 15-item GDS short form total maps to the LOINC short version total; the long-form GDS total (LOINC:48544-1) was rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT code for the ESS total score was found, so the NCIT instrument is a broad match.

column5: Scales for Outcomes in Parkinson's Disease - Autonomic Dysfunction Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT code for the SCOPA-AUT total score was found, so the NCIT instrument is a broad match.

column5: Schwab England activities of daily living scale [UPDRS]
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: LOINC has the Schwab and England ADL scale, but only within the original UPDRS, which may differ from the standalone (modified) scale used here; NCIT UPDRS - Schwab and England % ADL Score (PD) (NCIT:C111611) and the with-dyskinesia variant (LOINC:77716-9) were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Searches for UPSIT, smell identification, University of Pennsylvania, smell test, odor identification and olfactory test in LOINC and NCIT found no term for the 40-item smell identification test total; NCIT Odor Detection (NCIT:C139027) was rejected as a materials-testing concept.

column5: REM Sleep Behavior Disorder Screening Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT code for the RBDSQ total score was found, so the NCIT instrument (synonym RBDSQ) is a broad match.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC code exists for an alpha-synuclein seed amplification result, so the protein is a related match per the guidelines; NCIT Alpha Synuclein Protein Measurement (NCIT:C142272) was rejected because it is quantitative, and the tissue immunostain code (LOINC:49456-7) because its specimen and method differ.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Maximum ThT fluorescence in RFU is a relative assay readout with no LOINC code, so it may only be related to the protein alpha-synuclein; sssom:NoTermFound is a reasonable alternative because Fmax is a kinetic readout rather than an analyte amount.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC code for alpha-synuclein mass concentration in CSF was found, so the protein is a related match per the guidelines; NCIT Alpha Synuclein Protein Measurement (NCIT:C142272) as a broadMatch is a close alternative.

column5: Amyloid beta 42 peptide [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Component, CSF specimen and mass/volume property (pg/mL) all agree; the plasma code (LOINC:33200-7) and the ratio codes were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Total tau mass concentration in CSF with no method stated matches the method-less code; the immunoassay-specific code (LOINC:101649-2) was rejected because the variable states no method.

column5: Phosphorylated tau 181 [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid by Immunoassay
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Component, CSF specimen, mass/volume property (pg/mL) and the stated immunoassay method all agree; the plasma code (LOINC:103675-5) was rejected.

column5: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A serum NfL result in pg/mL measured by Simoa (an immunoassay) matches the Ser/Plas mass immunoassay code, as no serum-only code exists; the molar plasma code (LOINC:112614-3) was rejected, and broadMatch is possible if Ser/Plas is read as broader than serum.

column5: Neurofilament light chain [Moles/volume] in Plasma by Immunoassay
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Plasma NfL in pmol/L requires a moles/volume code, and this is the only one; the mass code for Ser/Plas (LOINC:101281-4) was rejected.

column5: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: NfL in CSF in ng/L (a mass unit) matches the CSF mass/volume code.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A SomaScan RFU value is relative and has no LOINC code, so the measurement is related to the NCIT protein GPNMB, as the guidelines require; the GPNMB Gene term (NCIT:C113114) was rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: An Olink NPX value is relative and has no LOINC code, so the measurement is related to the NCIT protein GPNMB, as the guidelines require; the GPNMB Gene term (NCIT:C113114) was rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: An Olink NPX value is relative and has no LOINC code, so the measurement is related to the NCIT protein Cathepsin B; the CTSB Gene term (NCIT:C28405) was rejected.

column5: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by High sensitivity method
column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Serum CRP in mg/L (mass) by a high-sensitivity method matches this Ser/Plas code; the code with no method (LOINC:1988-5) and the moles code (LOINC:76486-0) were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Serum uric acid in umol/L requires the moles/volume code; the mass code (LOINC:3084-1) and the mass-or-moles code (LOINC:35232-8) were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: HbA1c reported in % is the mass fraction of total haemoglobin in blood with no method stated; the HPLC (LOINC:17856-6) and IFCC (LOINC:59261-8) codes were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The red cell count per uL in CSF matches the number-concentration code for CSF; the body fluid code (LOINC:26455-6) was rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Laboratory Test Fasting Status (LBFAST) records whether the specimen came from a fasted subject; the close alternatives Fasting Status at Specimen Collection (NCIT:C70928) and Fasting Status Indicator (NCIT:C93566) could equally be chosen.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Searches for freeze-thaw, freeze thaw, thaw cycle, number of thaw and thawed in NCIT, OBI and LOINC found no term for a count of freeze-thaw cycles; Thawed Specimen (NCIT:C158280) was rejected as a specimen condition rather than a count.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Searches for specific binding ratio, binding ratio, DaTscan, ioflupane, dopamine transporter, putamen, striatal and SPECT in LOINC and NCIT found no term for a left-putamen DaT-SPECT binding ratio; Ioflupane I-123 (NCIT:C80644) and Putamen (NCIT:C12452) were rejected as the tracer and the anatomy only.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Searches for specific binding ratio, binding ratio, DaTscan, ioflupane, dopamine transporter, caudate, striatal and SPECT in LOINC and NCIT found no term for a right-caudate DaT-SPECT binding ratio; the tracer Ioflupane I-123 (NCIT:C80644) was rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The column identifies the assay plate, so it maps to the plate's identifier; Run Identifier (NCIT:C117058) and Batch Number (NCIT:C104504, a manufacturing lot) were rejected.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No levodopa equivalent daily dose term was found in NCIT or LOINC, so the generic Daily Dose is the closest broader term; sssom:NoTermFound is a reasonable alternative because LEDD is a derived sum across drugs.

column8: Mapping agent v2 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The MDS-UPDRS item recording whether the patient is ON or OFF at the motor examination matches this variable; MDS-UPDRS - Taking Levodopa (NCIT:C100500) was rejected.
